fields.subject: Shard Targeting Values
fields.trigger: ShardsValues: ShardListForeign is called with an excluded shard identifier and a collection of virtual compound keys or keyed models, at any of the one-to-four identity levels and through either the List<> or the IList<> overload
fields.response: return one empty shard entry for each distinct input shard identifier that differs from the excluded identifier
fields.postcondition: the result contains neither the excluded identifier nor duplicate remaining identifiers
